[[Light My Fire]] | followed by = [[When Kappa Attack (Hard mode)]] | map = [[File:Light My Fire (Hard Mode) Drake Locations.jpg|300px]] | map1text = A possible path taken during the quest. }} Help [[Lei Jeng]] to track down some escaped drakes in [[Hard mode]]. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Meet Imperial Guard Lei Jeng in [[Xaquang Skyway]] * Find and capture the [[missing Fire Drake]]s: [5...0] of 5 remaining. * Prevent the [[Am Fah]] and the [[Jade Brotherhood]] from taking the Drakes. * See Lei Jeng for your reward. ===Reward=== * 5,000 [[Experience]] * 2,000 [[Gold]] * [[Imperial Commendation]] * Imperial Commendation ===Environmental changes=== * While this quest is active, [[Ghial the Bone Dancer]] and [[Orosen, Tranquil Acolyte]] will not [[spawn]]. == Notes == * The spawn points of the Missing Fire Drakes in this quest are different from the spawn points of the normal mode version. ==See also== *Quest walkthrough, NPCs, dialogue, trivia, and additional notes can be found on [[Light My Fire]].
